description: This Java class, LocalHostAddressSupplier, provides a singleton implementation that retrieves and caches the local host's IP address using the hostname obtained via HostNameSupplier. It throws an error if the host cannot be resolved.

classes.name: LocalHostAddressSupplier
classes.description: A singleton class that supplies the local host's network address, caching it after first retrieval. Throws a custom error if hostname resolution fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocalHostAddressSupplier, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the cached local host address, resolving and caching it if not yet set.

methods.name: tryToGetHostAddress
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the hostname to an IP address, throwing an error if resolution fails.

methods.name: getHostAddress
methods.description: Resolves a hostname to its IP address using InetAddress.
